rules.statement: The dismissal of a claim on the ground that it was improperly made is not an order falling under sections 244, 245, or 246 of the Civil Procedure Code; and the claimant in such a case is not obliged to bring an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code to establish his right to the property claimed.
